meta_description: About A Migrant's Diary — an independent editorial project for Sinhala speakers and others navigating Australia.

hero.title: About this project
hero.lead: A Migrant's Diary — සිංහල ඔසියා — is a personal editorial project. It is not affiliated with any political party, employer or government agency.
hero.lead_si: A Migrant's Diary — සිංහල ඔසියා — personal editorial project එකකි. Political party, employer හෝ government agency එකකට affiliated නොවේ.

sections.title: What this is
sections.body: A bilingual space for plain-language explainers on migration policy, Australian systems and migrant daily life. Content is written for readers who want context before they decide what they think.
sections.body_si: Migration policy, Australian systems සහ migrant daily life පිළිබඳ plain-language explainers සඳහා bilingual space එකක්. Readersට තමන් think කරන්නට පෙර context අවශ්‍ය අය සඳහා ලියනු ලැබේ.

sections.title: What this is not
sections.body: This is not a campaign site, a news wire, or legal advice. Always check official sources and qualified professionals for decisions that affect your visa, tax or health.
sections.body_si: Campaign site, news wire, හෝ legal advice නොවේ. Visa, tax හෝ health වලට affect වන decisions සඳහා official sources සහ qualified professionals check කරන්න.

sections.title: Facebook
sections.body: Our Facebook page carries shorter updates, links and discussion prompts. This website hosts longer tables, articles and reference lists.
sections.body_si: Facebook පිටුවේ shorter updates, links සහ discussion prompts. Website එකේ longer tables, articles සහ reference lists.

my_thoughts.title: My thoughts
my_thoughts.body: I started the page because friends and family asked the same questions in Sinhala — and the answers were scattered across English-only sites. I hope this site saves someone else that search time.
my_thoughts.body_si: Friends සහ family සිංහලෙන් same questions අහන නිසා page එක start කළා — answers English-only sites across scattered. Someone elseගේ search time save වේ යයි හිතනවා.
